comment: Toolchain contract for the intended CI execution image / toolcache (issue #147, Q6). Workflows probe the provisioned tools against this file before running setup actions: a warm rig that already satisfies the contract skips the download entirely, and any drift fails the job in a controlled way after setup. Versions are a recorded baseline, not a freeze: bump them here together with go.mod / the workflow pins. Chrome is a moving stable channel, so the contract pins presence and the binary name and records the found version instead of an exact build.
